composition_contract.arithmetic: Every configuration selects the pinned integer-modeled core FPU. NaN-like labels identify raw patterns; no IEEE host-float behavior is substituted.
composition_contract.boundary: Native address-width, recursion and allocation/history limits are independently tested wrapper refusals, not attributed to the unbounded Python memory implementation.
composition_contract.callbacks: Authored clear/link callbacks modify supplied memory. Pokes carry callback ordinal separately; Memory.store also appends its own log. Neither operation is silently promoted to a Model write. Missing handlers explicitly use the reference zero-result policy.
composition_contract.exceptions: Only the authored CallbackFailure is normalized in result entries; unexpected reference errors fail generation. There is no failure latch or rollback in this primitive.
composition_contract.memory: Complete sorted sparse byte map, including explicitly stored zero bytes. Unwritten bytes read zero without materialization. Raw addresses and stale targets remain numeric, never host pointers.
composition_contract.ordering: A recording subclass wraps original Model._w and Model.call without replacing their behavior. Ordered write/call events are recorded before the original operation, matching original model logs and exception timing.
composition_contract.reference_execution: Both modules and the prose specification are read using immutable git show, SHA256-verified and temporarily materialized only under ignored work. No live research module import or C++ result feeds expectations.
